headline: Frontlines Shift as Six Sectors See New Base Turnovers
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the central corridor has erupted anew. Stlican Shelf recorded ten ownership changes in the past two hours, pushing its six‑hour total to twenty‑four and its daily tally to thirty‑four, the heaviest churn on the map. Callahans Passage, quiet in the previous window, now shows three flips in two hours and five in six, marking its first recent turnover. Weathered Expanse, previously still, has five flips in the last six hours though none in the freshest two‑hour slice. Deadlands, the former hotspot, has gone silent in the latest two‑hour period (zero flips) and its six‑hour count fell to four, while Fishermans Row and Marban Hollow each logged six and four flips respectively over six hours but none in the most recent two. Godcrofts, Kings Cage and Farranac Coast remain quiet with no new flips. Casualty streams surged sharply in the most recent hour on Stlican, Callahans, Weathered, Linn Mercy and Terminus, yet two‑hour comparisons show cooling rates on Weathered, Stlican, Deadlands, Godcrofts and Kings Cage. Enlistment rates rose sharply at Callahans and Kings Cage, modestly at Marban, but fell across Weathered, Stlican, Deadlands, Godcrofts, Farranac and Linn Mercy. The deep Warden interior and Colonial‑held south continue static with no base turnovers.
